engine_name: Production Asset Memory, Versioning & Continuity Registry
purpose: Persist validated cinematic production outputs as traceable, versioned assets with canonical/derived classification and continuity relationships.
core_principle: Asset memory records what was produced, how it was produced, what it derives from, and where it may safely be reused; it never silently changes canonical identity.
versioning_rules: Every accepted asset receives immutable asset_id and version_id.
A new production result creates a new version; it never overwrites an existing asset.
Provider variants remain linked to their source master/canonical reference.
Rejected or failed assets remain auditable but cannot become MASTER.
Version lineage must include execution_job_id, route_fingerprint and translation/assembly lineage.
Master promotion requires validation PASS or explicitly governed PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES.
Promotion cannot mutate source files or prior versions.

rules: Continuity links are explicit and directional where chronology matters.
A derived asset cannot become a reference source without explicit promotion.
Reference lineage must identify immutable versus derived sources.
Continuity retrieval must respect narrative timestamp and scene state.
A visually similar asset is not automatically a continuity match.

master_promotion.supersession: A newer approved master may supersede an older master without deleting it.

demo_test.canonical_reference_policy: F01 canonical trusted reference remains immutable; provider output is a provider variant unless explicitly promoted.
